mission.objective: Make the chat the primary app entry point; configure Ollama Cloud through a user-selected API-key or local CLI-session mode; list agents; create an agent through a reviewed chat proposal; and chat with configured agents using Ollama Cloud, preserving BAGO authorization boundaries for all material actions.
mission.title: Agent Chat Control Plane

deliverables: Chat control message and agent draft contract
done_when: API-key and local Ollama CLI modes are distinct
Provider secrets are never returned to the browser or written into chat/session data
Agent creation is a proposal until human confirmation
Only existing, explicitly registered capabilities can be invoked
Unknown app actions remain proposals and cannot execute
work_items.title: Freeze chat control, provider and agent proposal contracts

deliverables: Agent inventory and conversational draft/confirm API
done_when: Both user-selectable authentication modes are explicit and report distinct states
Secrets are handled only on the backend and are not exposed by status/list APIs
Provider or model failure returns a visible error and no simulated response
Agent draft does not create an agent until explicit confirmation
Creation validates the frozen allowlist and persists a stable unique identity
Chat config is loaded by agent ID from the server and never trusted from browser-supplied config
work_items.title: Implement Ollama provider configuration and governed chat APIs

deliverables: Backward-compatible legacy ID and nullable provider/model read path
No-write migration behavior for stored legacy records
done_when: Valid agent_[0-9a-f]{8,32} records matching their filename appear in inventory
Missing provider/model is exposed as null and preserved on disk
Chat may use only the currently selected provider/model for that request when legacy config has no model
Malformed/untrusted stored data remains rejected or warned; new records remain 32-hex IDs
work_items.title: Preserve legacy agent inventory and request-scoped model fallback

deliverables: Chat as app home with links to existing views
Provider setup UI with API key and Ollama CLI session choices
done_when: The Inspector and other portfolio views remain reachable from chat-first navigation
Provider setup never persists a secret in localStorage or renders it after save
Empty, loading, configured, unauthenticated and error states are clear
The user can review or cancel an agent draft before it is created
No response is presented as live model output unless the backend call succeeded
work_items.title: Build chat-first shell, provider setup and conversational agent creation

deliverables: Loopback API default and explicit local CORS allowlist
Docker UI port bound to host loopback
LAN exposure limitation recorded in contract
done_when: Standalone API defaults to 127.0.0.1
Docker host port is published only on 127.0.0.1 while container listener remains reachable internally
CORS no longer permits wildcard origins
Contract states LAN exposure needs an authenticated API boundary
work_items.title: Restrict unauthenticated provider configuration API to host-local UI origins

deliverables: Fail-closed provider capability reporting for unsupported container mode
Host-local launch path using the OS credential backend and local Ollama CLI endpoint
done_when: Container mode never claims either Ollama auth mode is available when secure OS credential storage or host CLI loopback is not reachable
Provider UI visibly explains unsupported container auth and provides the local-host launch route
Container agent/provider/job data directories survive container recreation through host mounts
A Windows host-local launch script documents/prerequisite-checks the supported runtime without reading credentials
Final contract distinguishes host-local supported configuration from container limitations
work_items.title: Make provider and agent persistence runtime compatibility explicit

deliverables: Legacy Runner no longer emits simulated success/jobs
Legacy WebSocket chat uses selected configured model for agents without model binding
done_when: Legacy Runner WebSocket returns execution_unavailable and never creates success jobs or claims successful execution
Legacy WebSocket chat resolves absent agent model from currently selected provider/model per request and does not rewrite agent record
Contract states governed execution is not available until authority/permit/receipt path exists
work_items.title: Fail closed legacy runner and preserve fallback in legacy agent chat

deliverables: Shared explicit allowlist check for all WebSocket handshakes
done_when: Every WebSocket endpoint rejects missing or non-allowlisted Origin before accepting
Allowed browser origins are the same validated local origins as HTTP CORS
Rejected origins cannot run the demo, read agent chat, or access other WebSocket routes
work_items.title: Validate local browser origins before accepting WebSocket connections

deliverables: Residual risks and NOT_RUN evidence boundary
done_when: The report binds to the exact candidate fingerprint
Provider secrets are not exposed in API response shapes
No arbitrary model tool can execute an unregistered app action
Build/static checks and any unrun checks are reported accurately
No P0/P1 issue is left unaddressed or the terminal gate is held
work_items.title: Review provider, agent-creation and chat implementation against contracts

done_when: All handoffs validate
The independent review has no unaddressed P0/P1 finding
Exact current model/provider readiness is distinguished from code readiness
Unrun live Ollama calls and broader app-control capabilities are explicit
work_items.title: Close the Agent Chat Control Plane mission
